info.desc: Nothing's Shocking is the debut studio album by the American alternative rock band Jane's Addiction, released on August 23, 1988 through Warner Bros. Records. The album showcases the band's funk-oriented musical style through Dave Navarro's heavy guitar riffs and the distinctive singing style of vocalist Perry Farrell, and was one of the leading albums of the funk metal genre that made its breakthrough in the late 80's and 90's. Nothing's Shocking was well received by critics upon release and is often cited as the band's best album. Despite this, it peaked at number 103 on the Billboard 200 and produced .

podcast.body: Stephen Perkins' drumming on Jane's Addiction's 1986 debut album showcased his unique style, influenced by big band drummers. The track "Ted Just Admitted" serves as an example of his playing. "I think you'll see what I mean in this track called Ted Just Admitted from Jane's Diction's 1986 debut album Nothing Shocking."
